title: A Leo in love is a parade.
caption: Is your dream wedding a parade, a choir and twelve confetti cannons? Leo plans it all, then Aquarius asks for smaller. One popper, one rooftop, one shared playlist. Same size heart. Send this to the Leo planning their wedding.
